title: Brian's Boss Items
description: Plugins that adds custom Boss Items
body:

BossPlugin adds custom boss Items to your Minecraft SMP server. It has 3 unique items so far such as Warden Helmet, Dragon Helmet, and Wither Helmet. You can check the recipies on gallery tab. Perfect for servers looking to create new challenges and reward players with exciting content.


I upload my resourcepack on modrinth
                  |
                  |
                  |
                  |
                  V
                                         
[https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/brians-boss-items-resourcepack]

* **3 Unique Boss Helmets:** Craft powerful gear using rare late-game materials.
* **Custom Passive Skills:** Automatically triggers powerful defensive spells when you take damage.
* **Massive Stat Boosts:** Increases Max Health, Armor, Knockback Resistance, and Safe Fall Distance.
* **Custom Crafting Recipes:** Balanced recipes for survival gameplay.

---

🛡️ Helmet Details

🟦 Warden Helmet
For those who want to stand their ground like the terror of the Deep Dark.
* **Stats:** +5 Max Health, +5 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, +1 Knockback Resistance, +10 Safe Fall Distance.
* **Passive [Sonic Boom]:** When damaged, releases a powerful Warden sonic boom that knocks back nearby enemies. (Cooldown: 20s)
* **Recipe:** Echo Shards, Sculk Catalyst, Netherite Block, and a Netherite Helmet.

🟪 Dragon Helmet
Master the power of the End and rain fire upon your enemies.
* **Stats:** +4 Max Health, +4 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, +1 Knockback Resistance, +15 Safe Fall Distance.
* **Passive [Dragon's Domain]:** When damaged, summons 6 Dragon Fireballs in a circular pattern to blast away threats. (Cooldown: 30s)
* **Recipe:** Dragon Head, Dragon Breath, End Rods, Chorus Fruits, Netherite Block, and a Netherite Helmet.

⬛ Wither Helmet
Channel the destructive power of the Wither to protect yourself.
* **Stats:** +4 Max Health, +5 Armor, +4 Armor Toughness, +1 Knockback Resistance, +10 Safe Fall Distance.
* **Passive [Skeleton Circle]:** When damaged, shoots 10 Wither Skulls in all directions. (Cooldown: 30s)
* **Recipe:** Wither Skeleton Skulls, Wither Roses, Nether Star, Netherite Block, and a Netherite Helmet.

---
How to use

Download a plugin and resourcepack(in my other projects), and put it in your plugin folder in server. Everyone in the server need to use the resourcepack inorder to see the textures



______________________
Commands

/bossitem warden_helmet
/bossitem dragon_helmet
/bossitem wither_helmet

______________________
Permissions

bossitems.admin
